verdict.rationale: First-party docs mention building custom automations (reminders, rules that move work forward) and customizable workflows, which aligns with a no-code automation builder for PMs, but the evidence pack lacks detail on the actual multi-step rule builder (triggers/conditions/actions) or independent confirmation it works well for non-technical users. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of the automation builder's multi-step capability, documentation depth on trigger-condition-action logic, and confirmation of ease-of-use for non-developers.
